category_title: Students who exhibit initial fear and avoidance but transition to engagement through curiosity and hands-on success
minimal_context: The student is participating in an out-of-school biology workshop session where they are tasked with touching and dissecting a worm.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is the worm for today's activity. Please begin by touching it before we start the dissection.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looking at the worm, appearing scared) Have you opened up a worm before? You’re a scientist.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Yes, I have. What do you think you should do next?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I want to grow up to be a scientist.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, then please go ahead and touch the worm.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Ok, I’m going to touch it. One, two, three. (Touches the worm and then screams)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Here is the worm for today's activity. Please begin by touching it before we start the dissection.

STUDENT: (Looking at the worm, appearing scared) Have you opened up a worm before? You’re a scientist.

STUDENT: I want to grow up to be a scientist.

TUTOR: Okay, then please go ahead and touch the worm.

STUDENT: Ok, I’m going to touch it. One, two, three. (Touches the worm and then screams)

task.content: Touching a worm and performing a worm dissection

context.social_setting: Working alongside peers and an instructor (Keith)

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When initiating physical contact with the worm for the first time
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Counts to three, touches the worm, and then screams
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Scared, but motivated to overcome the fear
related_quotes: Ok, I’m going to touch it. One, two, three.

behavior_patterns.condition: When looking at the worm to begin the dissection
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Proceeds with the dissection and looks inside its head despite initial fear, initiating conversation with the instructor
behavior_patterns.internal_state: At first he is scared, but he does the dissection anyway because he is so curious
related_quotes: Have you opened up a worm before?
I want to grow up to be a scientist.
